cards.claim: Data centre load accounts for 66 per cent of the growth in NSW end-use energy consumption from FY26 to FY35.
In twelve months, Transgrid's forecast of data centre load growth to 2035 went up four times.
NSW's grid operator has received data centre connection enquiries totalling 20 gigawatts, roughly twice the entire state's peak demand.
City of Moreton Bay has published 16,519 development applications since 2016. The word "data" appears in none of them.
One grid operator's annual report says "data centre" 187 times. A decade of one council's planning applications says it zero.
A 113-page engineering report for Australia's largest proposed data centre states its grid connection, 2,160 MVA, and never once states how much electricity it will use.
The same report discloses 16.5 kilolitres a day of operating water. It discloses twenty times that for construction.
The capital investment value recorded for an Amazon data centre in Western Sydney is $14.7 million.
Of 94 Australian data centres tracked, one has both a disclosed value and a recorded approval date.
Supernode's planning approval was announced in July 2022. ChatGPT launched that November.
Street View, 2026. The site of a $3 billion data centre campus. The transmission towers on the horizon are the reason it is worth anything.
NSW minimum demand stops falling in 2029 and turns back up, because of data centre load.
In 2025 Queensland's transmission planner reported "limited interest from data centre proponents" and left them out of its load forecast entirely.
AEMO projected 90 GWh a year of data centre consumption for all of Queensland. One proposed site is around a hundred times that.
Queensland's current published transmission forecast contains no data centre projects. Its data is current as at September 2025.
In March 2026 NSW's grid operator reported 10 GW of data centre connection enquiries. By its annual report later that year: 20 GW.
Data centres connecting to NSW transmission range from 250 MW to over 1,200 MW, averaging 650 MW. Smaller ones connect to the distribution network instead.
